description:
TCMA = Tiered Contention Multiple Access
Runs on boot.
A form of CSMA/CA, a cellular traffic management protocol. TCMA schedules transmission of different types of traffic based on urgency.
China-only? (the"cn" in cn.oneplus is China's country code)
